title: Strings (strings.json)
description: All text the engine prints comes from here, so the engine names no content and writes no prose. Also holds reusable texts referred to as '@id'.

$schema.description: Path to this file's schema, for editors. Ignored by the engine.

engine.description: The engine's messages in the pack's words. Placeholders in braces, e.g. 'You enter {location}.', are filled in by the engine; each message may use only its listed placeholders. A missing message is shown as its key.

exit_blocked.description: An exit can't be used and gives no hint of its own. Placeholders: {object}, {state}.

needs.description: Default hint for an unmet requirement; 'needs' is a list of tag names joined with list_or. Placeholders: {needs}.

list_or.description: Joins the last two entries of a list of alternatives, e.g. ' or '. No placeholders.

list_and.description: Joins the last two entries of a list, e.g. ' and '. No placeholders.

nothing_here.description: Acting on an empty tile. No placeholders.

unknown_command.description: A typed command isn't recognised. No placeholders.

items_found.description: Items from searching or loot. Placeholders: {items}.

items_lost.description: Items taken or used up. Placeholders: {items}.

cargo_full.description: No cargo space left for an item. Placeholders: {item}.

cannot_fit.description: A thing doesn't fit in, through or onto something. Placeholders: {thing}, {container}.

skill_up.description: A skill level is reached. Placeholders: {skill}, {level}, {text}.

encounter_escaped.description: The player's side gets away. Placeholders: {encounter}.

overheated.description: A character reaches maximum heat. Placeholders: {character}.

phase_start.description: A new part of the day begins. Placeholders: {phase}, {day}.

go_to.description: Menu label for an exit without a label of its own. Placeholders: {destination}.

talk.description: Menu label for talking to someone. No placeholders.

inspect.description: Menu label for looking at something closely. No placeholders.

already_used.description: Why an interaction that can be used once (or once a day) is unavailable. No placeholders.

unavailable.description: Why an option is unavailable when it has no hint of its own. No placeholders.

keys_walk.description: Key hints while walking around. No placeholders.

keys_menu.description: Key hints while a menu is open. No placeholders.

keys_choice.description: Key hints while a choice waits for an answer. No placeholders.

day_phase.description: The day and part of the day, in the status panel. Placeholders: {day}, {phase}.

party.description: Who travels with the player, in the status panel. Placeholders: {names}.

pack_fitted.description: Heading for worn and fitted items in the pack panel. No placeholders.

pack_carried.description: Heading for carried items in the pack panel. No placeholders.

character_title.description: Heading of the character panel. Placeholders: {name}.

game_saved.description: The game was saved. No placeholders.

terminal_too_small.description: The terminal is too small to draw the game. Placeholders: {columns}, {rows}.

fit.description: Item menu: fit a frame, module or implant. No placeholders.

remove.description: Item menu: remove a worn or fitted item. No placeholders.

store.description: Item menu: put an item into storage within reach. No placeholders.

take.description: Item menu: take a stored item. No placeholders.

refit_needed.description: Fitting or removing needs a workshop that offers refit. No placeholders.

frame_worn.description: A frame is already worn. No placeholders.

frame_needed.description: Modules need a worn frame. No placeholders.

no_free_slot.description: No free slot for the item. Placeholders: {item}.

cannot_use.description: The character doesn't meet the item's fit requirement. Placeholders: {item}.

over_budget.description: The loadout would need more of a budget than it has. Placeholders: {stat}, {need}, {have}.

remove_modules_first.description: A frame comes off only after its modules. No placeholders.

storage_full.description: No room left in the storage. Placeholders: {container}.

item_fitted.description: An item was fitted or put on. Placeholders: {item}.

item_stored.description: An item was put into storage. Placeholders: {item}, {container}.

item_taken.description: An item was taken from storage. Placeholders: {item}, {container}.

pack_stored.description: Heading for items in storage within reach, in the pack panel. Placeholders: {container}.

keys_pack.description: Key hints in the pack panel. No placeholders.

encounter_round.description: Encounter header: its name and the round. Placeholders: {encounter}, {round}.

uses_action.description: Someone uses an action in an encounter. Placeholders: {character}, {action}.

intent.description: What an enemy is about to do, shown next to it. Placeholders: {action}, {target}.

on_cooldown.description: Why an action can't be used: still cooling down. Placeholders: {rounds}.

no_charges.description: Why an action can't be used: no uses left this encounter. No placeholders.

needs_item.description: Why an action can't be used: an item it uses up is missing. Placeholders: {item}.

skips_turn.description: Someone loses their action (overheated, stunned). Placeholders: {character}.

keys_encounter.description: Key hints in an encounter. No placeholders.

keys_target.description: Key hints while picking a target. No placeholders.

dismantle.description: Item menu: dismantle an item at a workshop. No placeholders.

repair.description: Item menu: repair a worn item at a workshop. No placeholders.

fabricate.description: Item menu: make a copy of a known design. No placeholders.

modify.description: Item menu: apply a modification. Placeholders: {modification}.

pack_designs.description: Heading for known designs in the pack panel, near a fabricating workshop. No placeholders.

needs_service.description: No workshop within reach offers this. No placeholders.

too_advanced.description: The workshops within reach can't work on an item of this grade. Placeholders: {item}.

needs_materials.description: Materials are missing; 'items' lists them with counts. Placeholders: {items}.

no_mod_slot.description: The item has no free mod slot. Placeholders: {item}.

already_modified.description: The item already has this modification. Placeholders: {item}, {modification}.

not_damaged.description: The item doesn't need repair. Placeholders: {item}.

item_dismantled.description: An item was taken apart; 'items' lists what it gave. Placeholders: {item}, {items}.

design_not_learned.description: Dismantling didn't teach the design (not skilled enough). Placeholders: {item}.

pack_more.description: The pack panel has more pages. Placeholders: {page}, {pages}.

string.description: Reusable text. Any text field that is exactly '@' plus this id shows it.
